help.lines: Grow your kingdom from a single city. Every city splits its gold between five budgets: ARMY trains the selected unit, TOWERS builds defensive towers and walls, WORKSHOPS builds workshops, LAND cleans pollution and grows the population, LEARNING funds research.
Select your Settlers in the garrison, press March and click a site inside the dashed supply circles. Settlers found a city when they arrive.
Scouts explore the map. Research Agriculture to settle harsh lands, Roads for supply range and speed, Masonry for cheaper workshops and units, Smithing and Fortification for war.
To conquer a city, defeat its army and towers, then send levies from a nearby city. Siege Rams destroy people and workshops.
A dragon guards Orion, the lost capital. Slay it and settle Orion for a great boost to learning. Defeat every rival kingdom to win.
race.human.trait: Merchant republic: cheap Fortification, Agriculture and Roads.
race.silicoid.trait: Mountain folk: settle any land, no pollution, slow growth.
race.sakkra.trait: Swamp tribes: double population growth, cheap Agriculture.
race.psilon.trait: Scholars: +50% learning and every field is cheaper.
race.alkari.trait: Sky riders: units take 20% less damage, cheap Roads.
race.klackon.trait: Tireless workers: double output per worker, cheap Masonry.
race.bulrathi.trait: Bear clans: +25 when storming or defending cities.
race.meklar.trait: Engineers: each person runs 2 extra workshops, cheap Scholarship.
